### Choose the boundary you already have
These helpers are consumer-private source imports, **not published package
subpaths**. Start with the object supplied to your component:
| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |

instances, A and B, in the same Graph: A waits for its simulated result while the
panel switches to B; B succeeds without settling A; A then completes while its
panel is detached, and reconnecting does not write again. Expect

it is not a production verification service. The writer simulates completion in

The application creates five actual input Nodes in four groups:
| evaluations | Immutable evaluation pack, arrivals and current input/policy facts |
| verification | Receipt from the independent fixture verifier, bound to the evaluated material |
| localAuthority | Permission grants, logical tick and stop facts; no default approval |
| inbox | The separately prepared `OfflineAlertResource` with its exact binding |

lines.text: Configuration allocates no graph nodes; compose creates a complete runtime.
Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only
select name/diagnostics. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and
resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token.
Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original
identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph.
Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes.
Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the
original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's
original references without introducing another identity registry.
| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |
| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |
| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |
| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |
| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |
| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |
| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |
For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records
per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted
write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or
automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or
proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application
must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery.
The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended.
The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination
are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether
someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove
The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing
public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a
direct substitute for this particular view contract.
Follow the actual request, admission and outcome references in the demo output to
the running graph. Then distinguish these three questions:
| Did this node's implementation change despite unchanged ID/edges? | Revision-bound source mapping within its declared coverage |
| Who changed it? | Separate provenance; an implementation digest alone gives no attribution |
| Which consequences remain unchanged? | Independent verification bound to the current revision and inputs |
Missing source binding means uncovered; missing provenance means unknown. An old
receipt does not verify a new implementation. Existing bounded source-change and
mutation evidence can be inspected in the [implementation review](../../docs/design/causal-graded-entry-implementation/README.md).
Those retained artifacts describe their own revisions; the new demo does not
requalify them or attest the loaded production source.
The example and offline tests demonstrate available composition paths, not a

Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Then distinguish these three questions:"},{"line":128,"text":""},{"line":129,"text":"| Question | Evidence required |"},{"line":130,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":131,"text":"| Did this node's implementation change despite unchanged ID/edges? | Revision-bound source mapping within its declared coverage |"},{"line":132,"text":"| Who changed it? | Separate provenance; an implementation digest alone gives no attribution |"},{"line":133,"text":"| Which consequences remain unchanged? | Independent verification bound to the current revision and inputs |"},{"line":134,"text":""},{"line":135,"text":"Missing source binding means uncovered; missing provenance means unknown. An old"},{"line":136,"text":"receipt does not verify a new implementation. Existing bounded source-change and"},{"line":137,"text":"mutation evidence can be inspected in the [implementation review](../../docs/design/causal-graded-entry-implementation/README.md)."},{"line":138,"text":"Those retained artifacts describe their own revisions; the new demo does not"},{"line":139,"text":"requalify them or attest the loaded production source."},{"line":140,"text":""},{"line":141,"text":"The example and offline tests demonstrate available composition paths, not a"},{"line":142,"text":"human usability result or superiority to a complete plain-code host. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. /** Internal delivery metadata used to preserve the upstream `ctx.down(msgs)` wave boundary. */
* Internal current-value reader. It is deliberately a symbol-backed implementation detail:
* raw ctx exposes `waveData` + `terminal`; helpers below derive from that plus this dep cache.
export const CTX_DEP_CACHE: unique symbol = Symbol.for("graphrefly.ctx.depCache");
/** @internal Attach per-dep wave-origin state without exposing it on the public Ctx shape. */
export function setCtxDepWaveOrigin(ctx: Ctx, origin: CtxDepWaveOrigin): void {
/** Internal node-construction binding for graph-local helper-created deps. */
export const CTX_NODE_BINDING: unique symbol = Symbol("graphrefly.ctx.nodeBinding");
/** Per-dep wave projections: dep -> waves -> values/SENTINEL markers. */

Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. * observe(path?) = read-only enveloped EGRESS (R-observe / D39). NOT a graph node — it

* No path = whole graph; an exact id = a single node; otherwise a `::`-prefix subtree.

// cold node runs its fn (and activates upstream); whole-graph observe() activates the
// graph. "Read-only" means it never emits/mutates node state, NOT that it avoids
// activation. Use it knowing inspection of a cold graph wakes it.
sink({ path: id, msg, tier: messageTier(msg[0]), seq: this._clock++ });

Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write.
