Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host.
